description: This file contains shell script code that implements tests for handling of ref names within Git, particularly focusing on invalid or badly named references, their creation, deletion, and renaming behavior, as well as handling of broken symrefs and edge cases involving ref validation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Marks a test condition that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.

methods.name: test_ref_exists
methods.description: Checks if a given ref exists.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given ref is missing.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within input.
